findings.text: follow-on: the new category predicate scopes the enrich/check claim queries and the enrich_phase/check_phase pending-work predicates, but the module-level has_pending_work (parallel.py:468) still calls has_pending_enrich_work/has_pending_check_work without the categories argument, so a category-scoped caller of that helper would see work in categories it did not ask for. Non-blocking: the signals pipeline itself completes through enrich_phase/check_phase (parallel.py:360-368), which do carry self.categories, so the scoped run drained and finished; has_pending_work has no in-package caller.

follow-on: the recorded no_data count does not reconcile. The evidence fragment states the remainder are success=false/error_type='no_data' reads without a count and the manifest follow_on states '237 census rows carry a genuine success=false no_data verdict at E101163'; the live graph returns 238 success=false edges at shot 101163, all error_type='no_data' (525 success=true + 238 success=false = 763 CHECKED_WITH edges). Off by one; the substance (a genuine no_data gap for those catalogue names at that shot) is correct.

follow-on (evidence): the reviewed run's manifest carries baseline_suite=null and after_suite=null (per its own classification.json) and test_logs names only gate2.log, so the run's own record cannot yield an added-failure count; gate2.log also has no revision/tree/command header (its first line is the pytest session banner), unlike gate.log which carries one. The gate measurement is nevertheless reproducible (re-run 0 added failures) but a coordinator reading only the manifest cannot see it.

follow-on: the run's declared orientation_write_paths include docs/figures/jt60sa-discovery-completion/edas-enrich-check and the brief calls the artifact a research fragment, but no figure was delivered — the fragment is text-only and the figures directory does not exist. justifications.durability: the category filter is one shared helper (build_category_predicate) used at every enrich and check claim site and at both phase pending-work predicates, so the claim filter and the completion gate cannot drift; four TestCategoryScope tests (test_signals_pipeline.py:779+) assert the rendered predicate and the $categories binding at each site, and the negative control (build_category_predicate returning literal 'true') reddens three of them at EXIT=1; the scanner source-path key is pinned by two new tests (test_edas_scanner.py:158+) including the name fallback. Dock for the unfiltered has_pending_work helper left behind.
justifications.evidence: every claimed figure reconciles with the live graph and the two gate arms were re-run (base 36 passed EXIT=0, head 42 passed EXIT=0, 0 added failures). Docked for the reviewed manifest's own under-declaration (null baseline/after arms, gate2.log without a revision header) and the 237-vs-238 no_data count.
justifications.fit: commits are conventional with bodies, carry no AI attribution and no plan identifiers (grep clean); the change reuses one helper rather than forking the predicate, keeps the FacilitySignalModel-construction idiom, and the evidence fragment is a bare <section> as the brief requires.
justifications.goal_fidelity: plan §2 / f-jdc-001 met end to end on the graph: 764 enriched, 763 checked, four named signals each a success=true edge at the data-carrying shot, spend USD 1.32 against USD 8. The reference shot is E101163 rather than the criterion's E101173 and the scanner change exceeds the brief's fences, but both are coordinator-authorized (plan comment 2026-10-05T08:20Z: probe downward from E101173 and check with --reference-shot, record the negative; and widen the node onto the scanner and its test) and the negative at E101173 (irc=1015 for PSRC) is recorded.
justifications.scope_discipline: the six changed paths equal the manifest's declared changed_paths; the scanner and its test are within the coordinator's recorded widening though outside the brief's original fence, and the one-time 82-row status SET is coordinator-authorized and recorded with its row count. Dock for the declared-but-undelivered figures path.
